title: The Willow Transform and the Blind Zone Theorem: A Sharp Information-Theoretic Obstruction in the Turán Hierarchy for the Riemann xi-Function
summary: Let Xi(t) = xi(1/2 + it) be the Riemann Xi-function, let Xi(t) = sum_{k>=0} (-1)^k c_k t^{2k} be its even Taylor expansion at the origin, and let D(n,r) = det[c_{n+i-j}] (i,j = 0..r-1) be the Toeplitz minors whose positivity for all n >= 0, r >= 1 is equivalent to the Riemann Hypothesis (RH). We prove a sharp and quantitative obstruction in the resulting hierarchy of criteria.
